note: Starter vocabulary — SPEC.md §16. One canonical internal tier per SPEC.md §7, displayed with region-specific labels so the site never has to pick a side between European letter-segments and US size classes. `labels.europe` / `labels.us` are what templates render; `id` is what content authors tag.

terms.label: A-segment / City car
terms.description: Smallest passenger cars, typically under 3.7 m.

terms.label: S-segment / Sports car
terms.description: Sports coupés, roadsters and GTs, where size class is not the organising idea.

terms.label: Small SUV
terms.description: High-riding body on a B-segment footprint.

terms.label: Compact SUV
terms.description: High-riding body on a C-segment footprint.

terms.label: Mid-size SUV
terms.description: High-riding body on a D-segment footprint, often with a third row.

terms.label: MPV
terms.description: One-box people carriers of any size.
